prompts.flat: Use case: style-transfer. INPUT is an earlier detailed painted reading-village map. Make design OPTION 1: CLEAN AIRY FLAT illustration. Re-illustrate the village completely; keep only the concept of five places connected by a meandering path, not the paint texture or realism. Wide 16:9 complete landscape for an elementary reading app. Strong simplification: use about 6–8 cheerful restrained solid colors, generous warm ivory open space, flat irregular geometric shapes, calm pale mint landscape, small terracotta post office, rounded forest library/open book, tiny circular sharing garden, plum-curtained stage, sky-blue bookmaking cottage. At most 2–3 tiny children drawn with very simple shapes. Sea as two plain blue bands, trees as clean rounded silhouettes, a few simple daisies and envelopes. Use clear silhouette and distinct destinations with ample space around them. Sophisticated modern educational editorial illustration, light and welcoming for ages 6–12. Prefer cream, light sage, powder sky blue, butter yellow and coral with very limited dark forest accents. Remove 85 percent of the reference details. No realistic foliage, no dense wildflowers, no textured paper, no crosshatching, no brush grain, no 3D shading, no gradients, no heavy outlines. NOT a UI mockup: no text, no numbered markers, no navigation, no labels, no borders. Full image; no montage.
prompts.pencil: Use case: style-transfer. INPUT is an earlier heavy painted reading village. Make design OPTION 2: AIRY COLORED-PENCIL SKETCH. Recreate only its five reading destinations as small, delightful, loosely hand-drawn illustrations on a mostly WHITE / very pale warm cream page. Wide 16:9. Keep the five places: reading tree with an open book bottom-left, little red post office upper-left-middle, two children sharing books in center, small purple-curtained theater upper-right, story-making cottage bottom-right. A single fine winding ochre pencil line connects them. This version must be dramatically lighter and simpler than the reference and clearly different from a filled flat landscape: 55–65 percent of canvas remains clean unpainted paper; distant sea is just two fine turquoise wavy lines; scattered 4–5 leaf sprigs and a tiny cloud only. Medium: delicate colored-pencil and thin graphite-like forest-green outlines, sparse light pastel pencil hatching inside small shapes, no dense watercolor fills. Friendly subtly irregular architectural lines and tiny expressive human gestures, editorial children's magazine quality suitable ages6–12, not baby-cartoon chibi. Warm coral, muted sea blue, fresh mint, lilac, pale sunflower; almost no heavy shadows. Objects feel lightly sketched and lightly colored, with controlled visible paper and breathing room. No realistic texture rendering, no dense trees, no huge foreground objects, no gradients, no 3D forms. No text, no labels, no numbers, no UI, no borders, no panels. Keep the composition harmonious and accessible, each little destination immediately recognizable.
prompts.paper: Use case: style-transfer. The input is a reference of a five-destination reading village. Design OPTION 3: MODERN MINIMAL CUT-PAPER COLLAGE. Completely reinterpret the village using bold elegant paper-cut silhouettes, NOT a detailed painting. Wide 16:9 image with generous warm off-white negative space. Place five charming small destinations along one broad pale-peach ribbon path: a forest-green tree and open cream book in lower-left, coral post office with blue mailbox upper-left, two minimally shaped children reading in the center, a plum/lilac theater upper-right, and turquoise bookmaking house with three oversized pencils lower-right. Recognizable through only a few large, purposeful forms. Add two or three abstract hill/sea shapes behind, no realistic landscape. A maximum of 3 paper layers per object and very subtle cut-edge shadows; tactile smooth matte colored paper, not thick foam, not 3D clay, not origami geometry. Art direction: contemporary sophisticated illustrated children's museum map, playful handmade warmth, clean hierarchy, bold but low-saturation warm coral, pistachio, lavender, sky blue, butter yellow. Simplify buildings to large rectangles and curved roofs; use circles and triangles for minimal leaves and books. 45 percent open light background. No fine lines, no detailed stonework, no roof tiles, no tiny flowers, no realistic people, no paint strokes, no busy texture, no text, no logos, no labels, no UI controls, no frames, no panels. Must look strikingly different from flat vector scenery and pencil sketch.
prompts.outline: Use case: style-transfer. INPUT is a detailed painting of a reading village. Create design OPTION 4: LIGHT ROUNDED STORYBOOK LINE ART. The same five reading destinations become a delightful modern comic-like illustrated map. Wide 16:9. Use simple confident slightly wobbly dark-teal rounded outlines of consistent medium weight, airy pastel solid fills, generous white space; lively expressive shapes, like a beautifully designed contemporary children's activity book rather than a preschool app. Each destination has only a few visible details: lower-left an open book beside a puffy rounded reading tree with a tiny library cabinet; upper-left a small coral-red post office with an envelope sign and a rounded mailbox; center two East Asian kids reading and talking on a round mat; upper-right a lilac theater with open curtains and a single star on its backdrop; lower-right a mint bookmaking cottage with giant pencils and a handmade book on a table. Connect them with a cheerful dotted winding trail, add four small doodle accents (a paper airplane, two leaves and a tiny smiling cloud). A few pastel blue wave lines at far right suggest the coast, and a soft pale-yellow hill is the only big backdrop shape. Energetic but calm, readable graphic shapes for elementary ages6–12, friendly proportions without oversized baby heads. Palette: creamy white, pale mint, pastel sky blue, butter yellow, coral and lavender, fine deep-teal line accents. More iconic and simpler than the reference: remove tile patterns, all dense flora and stonework, simplify characters to expressive faces and minimal clothes. NO paint texture, no pencil grain, no cut paper, no shadows, no gradients, no realistic landscape, no labels or typography, no UI controls, no borders, no multiple panels.
